assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4103, M-4103 and TT-4103 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 6 December 2006 a near hit was recorded on P-4103, M-4103 and TT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
